xDai is an EVM-compatible blockchain that runs as a sidechain bridged to Ethereum. xDai uses a stablecoin pegged to the US dollar as its gas token. xDai operates on a proof-of-stake consensus mechanism. xDai is a public blockchain on which smart contracts run without intermediaries.

Erasure is a protocol built on Ethereum smart contracts for curating and sharing data. Erasure uses staking and bonding curves to coordinate its participants. Erasure is open to anyone interacting through public blockchain infrastructure.

Harvest Finance is a yield aggregator built on Ethereum smart contracts. Harvest Finance automatically moves user funds between yield farming strategies to seek returns. Harvest Finance is governed through its FARM token holders. Harvest Finance runs on a public blockchain without a central intermediary.

Pyth is an oracle network that delivers market price data to smart contracts. Pyth sources its price data from first-party data publishers. Pyth distributes its price feeds across multiple blockchains. Pyth serves DeFi applications that rely on on-chain price inputs.

1inch is a decentralized exchange aggregator built on public blockchains. 1inch routes trades across multiple liquidity sources to find favorable prices. 1inch is governed through its 1INCH token. 1inch executes swaps through smart contracts without a centralized intermediary.
